messages:
alex_cs: TigerBay cutover day0 quick thread. dropping preflight findings so we can assign owners and get ETAs. short list.

maria_se: thanks alex — paste away and I'll spin up CS ticket.

alex_cs: summary: 1) missing egress rules for 3 Splunk endpoints, 2) KMS key policy needs cross-account principal from their infra account, 3) role for Redwood uploader `redwood-s3-uploader` not allowed in bucket policy, 4) audit-forwarder lambda timed out during dryrun, 5) renewal note: TigerBay asked about a 15% Q4 discount tied to a 99.95% Dedicated SLO.

sam_infra: can you share exact hostnames/CIDRs so I can file network change?

alex_cs: hostnames: splunk-logs.tigerbay.internal, splunk-collector-02.tigerbay, splunk-s3-forwarder.tigerbay. CIDRs: 10.12.0.0/22 and 198.51.100.0/24.

sam_infra: thanks. opening INFRA-7821 for egress with these details, assigning to netops. aiming EOD PST.

leah_eng: for KMS cross-account — which principal do they want? we normally add their role ARN with Decrypt/GenerateDataKey.

alex_cs: they requested arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/tigerbay-service-role and want DescribeKey included.

leah_eng: ok i'll draft the key policy snippet for them to paste into their side or for us to attach to the customer key.

leah_eng: ```
{"Sid":"AllowTigerBayAccount","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/tigerbay-service-role"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:DescribeKey"],"Resource":"*"}
```

maria_se: on the S3 role — do we have the uploader role in our account already? if so we need a bucket policy entry; if not, do they want us to create cross-account access?

alex_cs: they expect Redwood to assume `arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/redwood-s3-uploader` into our bucket for uploads. bucket must allow s3:PutObject on prefix `logs/tigerbay/`.

sam_infra: I'll validate the bucket policy. if missing, I'll add a tight statement limited to that ARN and prefix. target: tomorrow 12:00 PST.

alex_cs: audit-forwarder: dryrun failed with Lambda timeout. logs show a 30s handler timeout on `rbw-audit-forwarder-prod`.

leah_eng: paste the error snippet?

alex_cs: ```
[2026-03-22T14:03:11Z] ERROR Runtime.TimeoutError: Lambda handler timed out after 30.00s
    at Runtime.module.exports.handler (/var/task/index.js:45:12)
```

leah_eng: short-term fix: bump timeout to 90s and add a retry on transient 5xx. long-term: optimize multipart S3 PUT and parallelize. I'll open a PR for the lambda config change today.

maria_se: owners recap for CS ticket: sam_infra -> egress + bucket policy check, leah_eng -> KMS policy + lambda PR, alex_cs -> confirm ARNs with TigerBay and own renewal ask. I'll create CS-4489 and tag sales for the discount conversation.

opsbot: IncidentBot: CS-4489 created by maria_se 
Subject: TigerBay day0 cutover items (network/IAM/KMS/S3/audit). Priority: P2.

alex_cs: small follow-ups: 1) please confirm netops can open 198.51.100.0/24 to Splunk collectors, 2) confirm if TigerBay will rotate KMS within 30 days (they verbally agreed but we need doc).

sam_infra: netops confirmed. 198.51.100.0/24 whitelisted. change ID NET-9210.

alex_cs: amazing. final ask: can someone draft a 30-minute cutover checklist runbook I can send to TigerBay ops? short, step-by-step.

leah_eng: I'll drop a 5-step runbook in ~30m with exact commands and validation steps.

maria_se: thanks team. I'll update the customer board, log the renewal_risk as "moderate", and ping SalesOps on the discount ask (do not commit).

alex_cs: :thumbsup: closing out for now. will post blockers here if anything pops up.
